scenario.name: Normal demand
scenario.text: 4 arrivals/h on a commuter profile (offered load ≈ 10 Erlang on 12 bays with 2.5 h stays), the default vehicle mix.

scenario.name: Peak demand
scenario.text: 7 arrivals/h on a commuter profile (offered load ≈ 17.5 Erlang): demand above the facility's capacity.

scenario.name: Charging-constrained
scenario.text: Normal demand, but 70 % EVs, 80 % of them with a receiver, and a 20 kW grid limit: wireless bays and power are scarce.

scenario.name: Sensor faults
scenario.text: Normal demand; one conventional and one wireless bay read uncertain from 09:00 to 12:00.

scenario.name: Communication loss
scenario.text: Normal demand; guidance and charger scheduling lost from 10:00 to 12:00 (local barrier and charger protection unaffected).

scenario.name: Charger outage
scenario.text: Normal demand; two of the four wireless chargers out of service from 09:00 to 13:00.
